newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices follow natgas to higher levels.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices follow natgas to higher levels.

text.p: Wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) moved higher again Thursday following stronger short-term natural gas physicals prices, industry sources said.
Spot south Texas natural gas prices rose significantly again Thursday, rising about 30 cents to near $3.55 per million British thermal units.
"It's the gas that's pushing our prices up," said one ERCOT electricity marketer.
ERCOT firm, peak power for Friday delivery was assessed in the $29.00-31.00 range, up from $26.00-27.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) in Wednesday discussion, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak non-firm ERCOT power transactions were pegged higher at $12.00-14.00 for Friday from $11.00-13.00 in Wednesday discussion, the sources said.

ERCOT December peak power was discussed at $32.00-33.75 from $29.50-31.25 on Wednesday, while January/February power prices were lower at $29.00-30.00 from $30.00-31.00 on Wednesday, the sources said.
